meta.name: ceo-advisor
meta.description: Pressure-tests a decision, plan, or idea before it is committed to — surfacing the assumption it rests on, the case against it, and what would have to be true for it to work. Use this when weighing options, when a plan needs challenging before commitment, when you have already decided and want a genuine gut check, when processing meeting notes into decisions, or when competing initiatives need ranking. Distinct from `chief-executive`, which owns direction; this one interrogates a specific decision.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检验重大决策,暴露它依赖的假设与可能的失败点
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在做出重要决定前需要有人帮你挑战思路、发现盲点
copy.tagline_en: Test a decision before committing by surfacing assumptions and counterarguments
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to pressure-test a plan and uncover hidden assumptions before committing.

howto.what: 它会扮演专唱反调的高管顾问：先厘清你真正要决定的问题以及这事能不能反悔，再逐条拆解计划的关键假设、最强反对理由和这件事会牺牲什么；计划站不住就直接说出来，并按固定清单给出建议、反方观点、什么会改变建议和本周第一步。
howto.when: 当你在权衡多个选项、计划在拍板前需要被挑战、或已做了决定却想要一次真正的检验等场景都会触发。

say.text: 帮我压力测试“下季度先招一名销售”这个决定。
say.note: 它会先澄清真正要决定的问题，并给出最强反对理由。

say.text: 三个项目都在争同一个资源，帮我排个先后。
say.note: 它会按瓶颈约束强制排出顺序，不搞并列。

say.text: 我之前决定砍掉客服外包，现在检查一下执行得怎样。
say.note: 它会先核对原定承诺与实际结果，再指出差距。

howto.what_en: Contrarian advisor: clarifies the real decision and reversibility; exposes the key assumption, strongest counter-case, and what it rules out; says plainly if weak; checks old commitments; returns a brief: recommendation, counter-case, what would change the mind, first step.
howto.when_en: Use when weighing options, when a plan needs challenging before commitment, or when you have already decided and want a genuine gut check; similar cases apply.

say_en.text: Stress-test my plan to hire a salesperson next quarter.
say_en.note: It restates the real question and argues against.

say_en.text: Three projects compete for the same resource; help me rank them.
say_en.note: It forces a strict stack ranking, not tiers.

say_en.text: I decided earlier to cut outsourced support; check how that commitment is going.
say_en.note: Compares original promise to actual outcome.
